title: Used Musical Instruments Staffage Collection
description: Use a massive wave of Opus 5.5 agents to extend the staffage with a huge collection of used instruments. Forty handcrafted second-hand musical instruments and music equipment (strings, keyboards, woodwinds, brass, percussion, folk instruments, amplification and stage equipment) in the staffage archive `🎓️teaching/🏛️architecture/🧍️staffage`, categories objects and appliances, each with rig, poses (stored in case or on stand, carried, played), clips, thermal and structural model, 2D representations and 3D volumes at 1:50, 1:100, 1:200, 1:500, manifest rows and the collection `used-instruments`, verified by the product's validators and tests.
summary: 21 used musical instruments are published in the staffage catalog and manifest; each validates with 0 issues and passes the product check CLI in the catalog-wide run of 2026-11-23. The viola was corrected in its generator so that its three views agree in every pose and clip. 19 rows of the assignment were never started and stay unstarted by the dev's order to finish started rows only. Not every sheet was opened. Evidence: instruments.md and three-views-2.md in ticket 26/11/22/GET-STAFFAGE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AND-FINISH-ALL-STAFFAGE-TICKETS.
